description: SignalR contract implemented by GameHub at /gamehub. JSON property names are camelCase; enum values are strings.

clientToServer.description: Starts a player-versus-engine game. The polymorphic type discriminator selects classic or clash options.
Joins the queue for a player-versus-player game. A match is created when another player requests the same mode.
Rejoins an existing session using the per-player token returned when the game starts or a match is found.
Removes the caller from all multiplayer matchmaking queues.
Resigns the caller from the active game.
Submits a move for the active session.

payload.promotion: Pawn | Rook | Knight | Bishop | Queen | King | null

serverToClient.description: Emitted when the game state changes or after a successful rejoin.

payload.status: InProgress | WhiteWonByCheckmate | BlackWonByCheckmate | WhiteWonByResignation | BlackWonByResignation | DrawByStalemate | DrawByInsufficientMaterial | DrawByThreefoldRepetition | DrawBy75MoveRule

piece.type: Pawn | Rook | Knight | Bishop | Queen | King

serverToClient.description: Sent to each player once matched. The token is required to rejoin that player's session.
Sent when a submitted move is invalid.
Sent when a hub operation fails.

sessionLifecycle.token: Returned by StartGame or in MatchFound; pass it to Rejoin.
sessionLifecycle.storage: Sessions are held in server memory and are not durable across server restarts.
